summary: Place-based environmental science diplomas. No institution-wide sustainability plan, STARS rating or climate targets found.
oc_use: A curriculum-only sustainability posture. A useful contrast to OC's integrated four-pillar approach.

summary: No sustainability, climate or environmental goals surfaced in the institutional strategic plan. A CNC CCAR exists via the provincial index.
oc_use: A negative benchmark showing how far ahead a published four-pillar plan already puts OC.

summary: Legislated 5-step process for all public sector organizations: measure, reduce, offset with BC offsets, report, verify. 2025 cycle: data by Apr 30 2026, CCAR due May 31 2026.
oc_use: Confirms OC's mandatory offset-purchase obligation and reporting calendar. Belongs in Carbon Zero's Financial & Risk Realities.

summary: Live registry confirming current versus expired ratings for every institution.
oc_use: Standing tool for OC to re-check sector rating status rather than relying on stale press coverage.

summary: 1,253 tCO2e, 58% below the 2007 baseline and a 51% energy-intensity cut since 2007. 2025 actions include 12 heat pumps at Downtown Campus, an LED retrofit, a Kitchen Electrification Project, and an instructional fleet with electric semis and hydrogen fuel-cell vehicles.
oc_use: Closest mandate-match CCAR in BC. Also the clearest example of framing a trades teaching fleet as both an emissions line and a curriculum asset.

summary: Pre-2015 but retained: this is the last standalone environmental strategy VCC published and no successor was found. Lead / Live / Learn pillars, a 20% GHG reduction target 2010-17, green-trades training research, and sustainability competencies for graduates.
oc_use: A three-pillar plan architecture, plus a decade-long throughline: green trades training was set as an aspiration in 2014 and the 2027 CCEAI now delivers it.

impact_areas: Curriculum; Applied Research; Infrastructure; Trades for the Transition
summary: $291.3M expansion at Broadway Campus for 700+ new FTE, completion targeted 2027, purpose-built for zero-emission vehicle and clean-energy trades training and explicitly tied to CleanBC's 40%-by-2030 target.
oc_use: The flagship BC precedent for Trades for the Transition. Cite this when building the capital and curriculum case.

summary: Province of BC announcement of the Centre for Clean Energy and Automotive Innovation.
oc_use: The provincial framing and funding rationale, useful for a business case written for government readers.

summary: VCC is launching at least five new clean-energy programs from 2026, starting with a Clean Energy Technology Diploma and a Wind Turbine Maintenance Technician program, framed as a labour-market response to CleanBC.
oc_use: Evidence a trades-mandate peer has already moved from strategy to enrolled programs. De-risks OC's own green-trades curriculum proposals.

summary: $8M in energy savings since 2007, 47% energy reduction and 61% GHG reduction against 2007, exceeding BC's 2040 target. Also a Zero Waste Eco Heroes office-supply recycling program launched Sept 2024.
oc_use: A low-cost, high-visibility waste and engagement program replicable across OC's four campuses.

summary: 1,889 tCO2e, 13.4% below the 2010 baseline but up 17.1% year over year. 94% of emissions are stationary building energy. Offsets cost $45,348. The new Fulmer Family Centre targets LEED Gold and is fully electric.
oc_use: A cautionary data point: a Silver-STARS institution with an active energy plan still posted a year-over-year emissions increase. Useful for setting non-linear, honest OC targets.

summary: A 10-year academic plan that explicitly names climate in crisis as a challenge the university must address, alongside land and place-based learning and Indigenous reconciliation.
oc_use: Model for embedding sustainability into an academic plan rather than only an operational one. Relevant to OC's Academics focus area.

summary: STARS Silver, 55.02 points, submitted 2 July 2024, valid to 8 Aug 2027.
oc_use: An active Silver rating at a teaching-focused multi-campus peer. A realistic first-target benchmark alongside UFV and UNBC.

summary: Reports a 10-year Campus Energy and Emissions Plan target of 50% below 2007 by 2030, delayed by COVID. 73% of students use sustainable commuting per a 2024 survey. U-Pass BC and carpool incentives in place. A $1.5M NSERC Mobilize climate-research grant in 2023.
oc_use: The 73% sustainable-commute figure is a strong TDM benchmark. Also a model of public accountability tracking against stated targets.

summary: A multi-campus town-gown MOU including a dedicated climate-action commitment, a circular-economy commitment with 1.25 FTE faculty time and about $16,500, and an Indigenous partnership tied to the Atl'ka7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region Society.
oc_use: Template for formalizing sustainability MOUs with Kelowna, Vernon, Salmon Arm and Penticton. Directly analogous multi-campus town-gown structure.

summary: Institutional renewal vision referencing sustainability. No numeric targets found and no PDF located.
oc_use: Limited use as found. Would need a direct request to CapU for the underlying document.

summary: 176 tCO2e, fully offset at $4,400. Actions include lighting and HVAC scheduling optimization, metering recalibration, EV charging, and a planned 2026 propane-to-electric forklift swap.
oc_use: A minimum-viable CCAR at single-campus scale. Least transferable to OC's 45 buildings, useful mainly as a floor comparator.

summary: A Climate Action Task Force established Fall 2020 presented a draft Sustainability and Climate Action Plan after more than two years of consultation. No finalized plan was locatable.
oc_use: A stakeholder-townhall consultation format OC could mirror. Note the plan itself is not confirmed published.

summary: Task force formed Fall 2020 in response to student activism and Senate discussion. Student Climate Action Network established 2019. No numeric targets.
oc_use: A governance-process example only. Advocacy-oriented rather than metrics-driven.

summary: 742 tCO2e, up 4% year over year. A Strategic Energy Management Plan targets a 44% energy-use cut by 2029/30 against 2008/09. Critically, JIBC conducts wildfire-smoke and extreme-heat vulnerability and HVAC-filtration assessments, with a full climate vulnerability assessment planned for 2026.
oc_use: The best physical-climate-adaptation model found anywhere in this project. A direct template for a wildfire-smoke and extreme-heat HVAC resilience assessment across OC's four Interior campuses. Serves target T4.

summary: STARS Bronze, 32.33 points, submitted 25 Sept 2025, valid to 20 Oct 2028. Strongest category was Air and Climate at 9.98 of 11.
oc_use: The lowest active rating in the BC set. Useful as the realistic floor for a first scored submission, and shows a resilience focus scores well in Air and Climate.

summary: Formal disaster and emergency management credentials. Institutional capacity directly relevant to climate-resilience training.
oc_use: A potential curriculum partner if OC ever builds climate-emergency content into trades or general education.

summary: 274 tCO2e plus 534 t biogenic reported separately, offsets $6,700. Geothermal serves six buildings, a heat pump serves a 900 sq ft academic building, six Level 2 EV chargers installed, a Clean Fleet Plan in development, and plans to electrify Mobile Training Labs to eliminate diesel generators.
oc_use: Geothermal and heat-pump portfolio model, plus the idea of electrifying mobile training labs. Directly applicable to OC's own mobile trades assets.

summary: A 19,500 sq ft purpose-built teaching building with a live geothermal system, rooftop PV, and an educational solar array with three tilt and orientation configurations for hands-on student testing. Houses trades labs, gym, greenhouse and commercial kitchen.
oc_use: The strongest living-lab building model found. Instrumented, visible building systems used as teaching tools. Directly transferable to an OC trades building retrofit and to the Four-Campus Living Lab initiative.

summary: NVIT's culturally responsive Community Based Assessment service, Elder-led openings, strength-based feedback and individualized plans, serving 900+ students across 50+ communities since 2011.
oc_use: A governance and process model for embedding Indigenous protocols into institutional service delivery. Relevant to OC's Layer 0 even though it is not an environmental document.
